body.label: Target
body.html: Up to two enemies within ranged Weapon Range, checked from your firing spaces.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Move up to 2 units, attacking one target before and one after this movement with the same roll. On success, each takes 1 weapon Damage.

surges.html: Movement from this card does not trigger movement Reactions from either target.

rider.title: Lock - Salvo
rider.html: After resolving, preserve Lock through this movement even if briefly obscured, provided its target is visible at the end.
